baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath by rabbika and the sequence nahshurannahum, nuhdirannahum, hawla Jahannama, jithiyyan.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sovereign authority drives an aggregate that includes rebels into adversarial attendance, arranges it around a center, and lowers it to its knees; the two verbs mark collection followed by arraignment.

activation_trace.role: Lordship as sovereignty supplies the authority underwriting the oath and proceeding.
Driving and collecting a group supplies compulsory convergence toward a destination.
The defiant rebel supplies the character of the co-present agents.
Adversarial attendance supplies an arraignment-like stage before authority.
The region around a thing supplies circumferential placement around Jahannam.
Kneeling on the knees supplies the final bodily posture of subjection.

changed_reading.before: A general threat that they will be gathered near Hell.
changed_reading.after: A staged sovereign arraignment: compulsory collection, presentation, circumferential placement, and embodied submission.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-shayatin are brought hawla Jahannam and made jithiyyan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The remoteness of sh-t-n is reversed by h-d-r proximity; h-w-l supplies both circumference and a possible separating boundary, while j-th-w arrests movement. Dispersed agency is compressed into immobilized containment.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance supply the initial condition that forced attendance reverses.
Presence, visibility, and proximity supply the reversal of remoteness.
Circumference supplies the containing geometry.
A separator between two things sharpens the circumference into a possible holding boundary.
Kneeling terminates mobility inside the bounded arrangement.

changed_reading.before: People and devils are simply brought close to Hell.
changed_reading.after: Agents marked by remoteness are forcibly collapsed into a bounded ring where kneeling ends their freedom of movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following desire and converging on deviation culminate in collective convergence with rebellious agents; the coordinated objects 'them and the devils' can expose an alignment enacted before it became visible.

activation_trace.role: Driven collection turns prior alignments into one visible assembly.
Defiant rebels supply the agents with whom the humans are co-assembled.
Trailing and following supplies the prior follower relation.
The soul's pull toward desire supplies what directs that following.
Convergence upon evil supplies a social clustering that the later gathering makes manifest.

structural_cues: 19:59 links neglect, following desires, and meeting ghayy before 19:68 coordinates 'them and the devils' as objects of one gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, appetite, and convergence on evil; I supply the arrow that practiced alignment becomes co-assembly. A live alternative is simple co-presence with no follower-to-devil pairing.

changed_reading.before: The devils are an additional group included in the gathering.
changed_reading.after: Their inclusion may disclose the humans' prior alignment: followers and rebellious agents are made publicly co-present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated 'your Lord,' under whose command the spatial totality lies, together with explicitly negated neglect, turns the oath into an execution guarantee: no person or position can fall outside the collection.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies the guarantor named by the oath.
Binding command supplies ordered execution rather than uncontrolled movement.
The repeated lordship title binds command and non-forgetting to the same sovereign invoked in 19:68.
The branch supplies leaving or neglect; its explicit negation removes the possibility of administrative omission.

structural_cues: 19:64 places what is before, behind, and between under command and repeats 'your Lord'; 19:65 expands the domain to the heavens, earth, and what is between.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, comprehensive spatial ownership, and negated forgetting; I infer that these make the oath a guarantee of exhaustive execution. The alternative is that the context only reaffirms the title rhetorically.

changed_reading.after: The oath guarantees an exhaustive operation by a sovereign whose command spans every position and omits no one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding objection decomposes the event into loss of life, emergence, and prior creation from non-thing; h-sh-r therefore includes making the dead gatherable, while h-d-r names their subsequent presentation.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and driving supplies the assembly whose precondition the context exposes.
Visible presence supplies the stage after reconstitution and collection.
Loss of life supplies the condition from which gathering must operate.
Passage to the outside supplies emergence as the disputed transition.
Origination supplies the precedent for restoring gatherable subjects.
The knowable existent, explicitly negated in the verse, supplies the zero-state from which origination occurred.

structural_cues: 19:66 asks whether one who has died will be brought out alive; 19:67 answers with prior creation when the person was not a thing; 19:68 begins with fa- and the oath.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death, emergence, and origination from non-existence; I infer that gathering includes reconstitution before transport. The alternative is that 19:66-67 prove possibility without specifying any phase inside h-sh-r.

changed_reading.after: Gathering is the reconstitution-and-collection of the dead into persons who can then be visibly presented.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ring functions as a processing perimeter: aggregate first, extract the most defiant from each following-group, require arrival, rescue by separation, and leave the unjust in the repeated kneeling state.

activation_trace.role: The region around a center supplies the perimeter in which later operations can occur.
Pulling something from its place supplies selective extraction from the aggregate.
A mutually supporting following-group supplies the internal units from which selection occurs.
Arrival at a thing supplies the universal approach phase.
Escape by separation supplies removal of the protected from the common perimeter.
Leaving something supplies the residue after rescue.
The repeated kneeling posture identifies the unjust as those left in the focus scene's state.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from gathering and presentation in 19:68, to extraction in 19:69, universal arrival in 19:71, and rescue versus being left kneeling in 19:72.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered operations of extraction, arrival, separation, and leaving; I infer that the circumference is their processing zone. The alternative is that 'around' is only a location and the later operations do not depend on its topology.

changed_reading.before: The circle around Jahannam is the undifferentiated destination of the gathered.
changed_reading.after: The circle is a sorting perimeter: subjects are assembled there for extraction, universal approach, rescue, and a kneeling remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boast compares station and council, furnishings and appearance, then predicts worse place and weaker host; forced kneeling in a gathered public turns 19:68 into a visible reversal of social rank.

activation_trace.role: A present gathering supplies the public audience in which rank is reversed.
Kneeling supplies the bodily inversion of standing and station.
Station and residence supply one axis of the rivals' prestige claim.
The assembled council supplies prestige as public social placement.
Abundant furnishings supply visible material status.
Appearance and display supply the visual face of that status.
Lack of strength supplies the verdict that overturns the boast.
A mutually supporting host supplies the social power finally exposed as weak.

structural_cues: 19:73 asks which faction has the better maqam and nadi, 19:74 recalls superior furnishings and appearance, and 19:75 answers with worse place and weaker host.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prestige comparison and its reversal; I infer that public kneeling around Jahannam enacts that reversal spatially and bodily. The alternative is a comparison of outcomes with no ceremonial relation to 19:68.

changed_reading.before: Jithiyyan describes fear or helplessness at the destination.
changed_reading.after: Jithiyyan also stages a public demotion: claims to superior station, council, display, and host collapse into kneeling exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from juridical persons into agricultural and material residue; it remains anchored in h-sh-r B008 and j-th-w B002 and is sharpened by the extraction-leaving-remainder sequence. Render it only as a secondary process-image, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Post-harvest remainder supplies an image of what collection leaves exposed on the field.
A raised aggregation or mass supplies the material shape of a gathered remainder.
Pulling out from place supplies selection from the gathered mass.
Leaving supplies the remainder after rescue.
What remains supplies a contrasting persistence-image at the end of the window.

changed_reading.before: The gathered are a crowd awaiting judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the scene resembles a field after selection: a compact kneeling residue remains exposed around the center.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because al-shayatin denotes devils here while B002 is the long-rope branch; it remains valid only as a branch-level image joined to forced gathering, circumference, and extraction. Render it as an exploratory image of remoteness tightened into confinement, not as etymology or translation.

activation_trace.role: The long twisted rope and tether supply an image of stretched distance brought under restraint.
Driven collection supplies the force that tightens dispersed subjects together.
A separating barrier supplies the confining edge toward which the tether-image resolves.
Pulling from place supplies the subsequent selective tug within the restrained aggregate.

changed_reading.before: The devils are merely added to the human crowd.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their root image adds a tethered geometry: severed distance is drawn tight, bounded, and selectively pulled.

strongest_changes: The context turns the ring around Jahannam into a sorting perimeter through extraction, universal arrival, rescue, and a kneeling remainder.
The death-and-creation exchange makes h-sh-r reconstitution as well as relocation, with h-d-r as the later public presentation.
Prestige language of station, council, display, and host strength makes kneeling a public reversal of rank.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated jithiyyan in 19:72, together with n-z-a, n-j-w, and w-dh-r, converted a static threat into an inspectable process; distant material branches then exposed a contained residue reading without displacing the juridical baseline.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordination of humans and devils may mark causal alignment or only co-presence.
Hawla may define a functional holding perimeter or simply state location.
The harvest and tether images are branch activations and must remain qualified rather than lexical replacements.
